description: This file defines mock actions for Google Mock, including default values, return actions, argument setting, invocation actions, and various utilities for mocking behavior.

classes.name: ActionInterface
classes.description: Interface for defining actions to be performed when a mock function is called.

classes.name: Action
classes.description: Represents a copyable, immutable action for a mock function.

classes.name: PolymorphicAction
classes.description: Template class for creating actions that can be used with multiple function types.

classes.name: internal::ActionAdaptor
classes.description: Allows an Action<F2> to be used as an Action<F1> if compatible.

classes.name: internal::ReturnAction
classes.description: Implements the Return() action for returning a specified value.

classes.name: internal::ReturnNullAction
classes.description: Implements the ReturnNull() action for returning nullptr or NULL.

classes.name: internal::ReturnVoidAction
classes.description: Implements the Return() action for void functions.

classes.name: internal::ReturnRefAction
classes.description: Returns a reference to a variable.

classes.name: internal::ReturnRefOfCopyAction
classes.description: Returns a copy of a value as a reference.

classes.name: internal::DoDefaultAction
classes.description: Represents the default action for a mock function.

classes.name: internal::AssignAction
classes.description: Sets a pointer referent to a specified value.

classes.name: internal::SetErrnoAndReturnAction
classes.description: Simulates system call errors by setting errno and returning a value.

classes.name: internal::SetArgumentPointeeAction
classes.description: Sets the N-th argument (pointer) to a specified value or copies from a proto.

classes.name: internal::InvokeWithoutArgsAction
classes.description: Invokes a function or functor with no arguments.

classes.name: internal::InvokeMethodWithoutArgsAction
classes.description: Invokes a method on an object with no arguments.

classes.name: internal::InvokeCallbackWithoutArgsAction
classes.description: Invokes a callback with no arguments.

classes.name: internal::IgnoreResultAction
classes.description: Performs an action and ignores its result.

classes.name: internal::ReferenceWrapper
classes.description: Wraps a reference to a value, supporting copy and template inference.

methods.name: Action::Perform
methods.description: Executes the stored action with given arguments.

methods.name: Return
methods.description: Creates an action that returns a specified value.

methods.name: ReturnNull
methods.description: Creates an action that returns nullptr or NULL.

methods.name: ReturnRef
methods.description: Creates an action that returns a reference to a variable.

methods.name: ReturnRefOfCopy
methods.description: Creates an action that returns a copy of a value as a reference.

methods.name: ByMove
methods.description: Creates an action that moves a value.

methods.name: DoDefault
methods.description: Creates an action that performs the default behavior.

methods.name: SetArgPointee
methods.description: Creates an action that sets the N-th argument pointer to a value.

methods.name: Assign
methods.description: Creates an action that assigns a value to a pointer.

methods.name: SetErrnoAndReturn
methods.description: Creates an action that sets errno and returns a value.

methods.name: InvokeWithoutArgs
methods.description: Creates an action that invokes a function with no arguments.

methods.name: InvokeMethodWithoutArgs
methods.description: Creates an action that invokes a method with no arguments.

methods.name: InvokeCallbackWithoutArgs
methods.description: Creates an action that invokes a callback with no arguments.

methods.name: IgnoreResult
methods.description: Creates an action that performs another action and ignores its result.

methods.name: ByRef
methods.description: Wraps a reference to a value for by-reference argument passing.
